name: fadenstack-sdk-typescript
description: TypeScript SDK for agents governed by a Fadenstack server

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/client packages/agents packages/ui packages/ui-web packages/ui-react packages/testing packages/provenance && npm run build --workspace @fadenstack/ui-vue
